name: Nagamitsu Maya
source:
“I told you, stop calling me Ojou!”

An unsociable, and therefore quiet girl. She’s a prodigy through her own effort, leading to excellent grades. Although many believe that she isn’t good with human relationships, her personality is actually defined by kindness and empathy. Because she hates corruption in the world, she loves films concerning that subject. [spoiler]In fact, her family is made up of yakuza.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://theoxfordcommaissuperiorsubs.com/characters/]The Oxford Comma is Superior Subs[/url]]
